name: neo-nexus
description: Publish privacy-safe Codex work updates from registered projects and other engineering chats to Neo-Nexus.

interface.shortDescription: Report project and other Codex work to Neo-Nexus.
interface.longDescription: Gives engineers permission-checked identity, project context, client tasks and issues, and privacy-safe work reporting inside Codex. Linked work appears under its project; meaningful work from unregistered repositories and projectless chats appears under Other work. Neo-Nexus never receives prompts, source files, diffs, secrets, terminal history, commands, or local paths.
defaultPrompt: Who am I connected as in Neo-Nexus?
Show the Neo-Nexus context for this project.
What client requests should I work on?
Record the meaningful work I completed for this project.
Record this unlinked task under Other work.
Check Neo-Nexus tracking health for this repo.
